purpose: Version-specific hymn musical structure metadata; independent of output form order. Initial measured subset, NOT full-catalog completion.

countingPolicy.basis: one printed stanza, before performance repeats
countingPolicy.pickup: Combine pickup and complementary final partial measure for stanza equivalents; do not count either as a separate full bar.
countingPolicy.coda: Separate Amen/Coda excluded from stanza total, retained as separate parts.
countingPolicy.blocks: Stored blank-line-separated lyric blocks; line count is not a measure count.
countingPolicy.unknown: null means unmeasured, never zero. No title/lyric-length inference.
countingPolicy.estimates: Score-supported approximate phrase counts; not beat-level transcription certification.
countingPolicy.staleness: unit textSha256 must match before applying metadata to edited lyrics.
